# ADR-0006 event-contract baseline — GRANDFATHERED, NOT APPROVED.
#
# Every line is a Kafka topic produced with no AsyncAPI contract and no registered schema: raw,
# unversioned JSON on the wire. The Apicurio registry the ADR calls for is deployed; the contracts
# are not written. This file freezes that debt so it stops growing while #1916's migration runs.
#
# This file only SHRINKS. check-event-contract-coverage.py fails on a new entry AND on a stale one,
# so a line cannot outlive the debt it records. Migration order is in #1916: money-path topics
# first, BACKWARD compatibility enforced at the registry, producers before consumers.
#
# Regenerate deliberately, never as a way to make a red build green.
